title: How each harness loads DD, and which OpenCode hooks can carry text
body: Claude Code and Grok Build install plugins from a marketplace that auto-discovers skills/ (Grok mirrors Claude Code's layout almost exactly). Codex and OpenCode get their project configuration written by `deltadictum install --host codex|opencode`: Codex has no marketplace or npm pull, and OpenCode reads project skills only from .opencode/skills/. OpenCode has no hook shaped like PreToolUse: tool.execute.before outputs {args} only and session events return void. Text reaches its model two ways: experimental.chat.system.transform (once per turn; it rewrites the system prompt and breaks the prompt cache) and the output of tool.execute.after ({title, output, metadata}), which DD uses to append the memories that fired, and the inbox's reply, to the tool's own result; that output carries no exit status, so outcomes cannot be read there.
not_derivable: Verified 2026-09-19 against @opencode-ai/plugin@1.18.31's type definitions and a real plugin's compiled source, and on 2026-10-22 in live OpenCode 1.19.3 sessions; a first version written from a documentation summary got the signatures wrong.
